notes.title: Update: Consistent Controller Mapping (0.0509)
notes.content:
Dear Community,

In this update, we’ve adjusted the controller mapping. The activation of controls is now consistent, providing a smoother and more reliable gameplay experience.

We hope this change enhances your gaming experience. Thank you for your feedback and ongoing support!

Enjoy the game and best of luck!

Your Digital Datschi Team

notes.title: Update: Bug Fixes and Improvements for Skills & Visuals
notes.content:
Dear Community,

In this update, we've fixed some critical bugs and made visual improvements. Here are the details:

[list]
[*][b]Skill & Progression:[/b] A major bug was fixed where skills were automatically purchased without correctly adjusting the stats. This should now work as intended.
[/list]

[list]
[*] [b]Health Slider for Objectives:[/b] The health slider display for objectives has been visually improved to be clearer and more organized.
[/list]

[list]
[*] [b]Aimable Slot Display:[/b] A visual bug in the shipyard was fixed where the slot display appeared even when no weapon was selected. This issue should no longer occur.
[/list]

[list]
[*] [b]Skill Display (purchased, purchasable, etc.):[/b] The skill display has been reworked to be much more intuitive. It is now easier to see at a glance which skills have been purchased, which are available, and which can still be unlocked.
[/list]

We hope these improvements enhance your gaming experience. Thank you for your feedback and support!

Enjoy the game and best of luck!

Your Digital Datschi Team

notes.title: Bug Fix Update: Enhanced Gameplay and Issue Resolutions (0.0309)
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We’re excited to bring you the latest update, which includes important bug fixes to enhance your gaming experience. Here are the details:

[list]
[*][b]Bee Boss Fight: [/b]The battle against the Bee Boss can now be successfully completed. The boss can be eliminated as intended, and the fight ends correctly.
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Mouse Click Outside Screen:[/b] We’ve fixed an issue where the pause menu would activate if the mouse was moved out of the game screen and clicked outside the window. This unintended behavior no longer occurs.
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Resource Display in Skill Tree:[/b] The resource display in the skill tree has been corrected. All available resources are now shown correctly.
[/list]

Thank you for your patience and support! We’re continuously working to improve the game and appreciate your feedback.

Enjoy the game and good luck!

Your Digital Datschi Team
